summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved plan. _probe_ollama defers provider_readiness.ollama_probe_exception logging until terminal all-candidate failure, records earlier recovered candidate failures as redacted structured debug detail, and _check_opencode keeps successful fallback readiness OK without exposing debug in the provider payload. Regression coverage exists for default host.docker.internal-to-localhost fallback without exception noise, redacted recovered debug evidence, terminal OLLAMA_HOST_UNREACHABLE detail/logging, and single-candidate terminal exception logging. Existing AWF evidence records the pre-fix red failure plus passing focused OpenCode/Ollama pytest and touched-file ruff runs.
